elements_selected.content: Replace the existing mtime-only cache invalidation with two-tier invalidation per REQ-039 and ADR-009. Tier 1 (fast): check file mtime. If unchanged since cache, skip hashing — reuse all cached Merkle nodes. Tier 2 (authoritative): if mtime changed, re-read and re-hash the file. If the computed file Merkle root equals the cached root, skip all downstream processing (wikilink re-extraction, SPL re-extraction, theory cache invalidation). Only if the root differs does full reprocessing occur. Implement in cache.rs files_needing_reparse, updating the signature to return (Vec<PathBuf>, Vec<PathBuf>) where the first vec is 'needs full reparse' and the second is 'mtime changed but content unchanged'. Update src/main.rs cmd_index to use the two-tier result and skip downstream processing for tier-2 hits. Also update cmd_reason_status to use the new invalidation path: a file with unchanged SPL AST hashes does not trigger theory rebuild even if its file Merkle root changed (prose edit only).
